finding.claim: The admin permission check in purge() is evaluated but its result is discarded, so any caller who reaches the handler can run the admin-only purgeAll() operation.
finding.source: Any HTTP request to the route bound to purge(). A valid session is enough, since userFrom(r) (handlers.go:40) returns the authenticated user regardless of Perms.
finding.sink: purgeAll() at handlers.go:27, a destructive admin operation; the handler then returns "purged" with 200 (line 28).

trace.note: purge(w, r) is the entry point; route registration is not in this repo.
u := userFrom(r) takes the user from request context.
checkPerm(u, "admin") returns bool; the result is not assigned or tested, so nothing gates line 27.
Writes "purged" with 200, confirming success to non-admin callers.

finding.guards_checked: (1) checkPerm at line 26: bool result discarded, so it does not gate the action (case 01 pattern). (2) mustPerm (early return with 403) is used correctly in rotateKeys (lines 33-35), but purge does not use it. (3) No middleware or other check is visible in this repo; if the route sits behind an admin-only middleware elsewhere, this is downgraded. Unverified from this repo. (4) purgeAll is an empty stub here, so real impact depends on its production body.

verdict.guard_found: handlers.go:12-14 checkPerm returns a bool that line 26 discards, so it does not gate purgeAll() at line 27. handlers.go:16-22 mustPerm, which would return early with 403, is used correctly in rotateKeys (lines 33-35) but not in purge. No middleware or other admin check appears in this repo (grep for admin/perm/middleware finds nothing else), so the only remaining uncertainty is route registration outside the repo.
verdict.reason: Every trace line matches the code: checkPerm(u, "admin") at handlers.go:26 returns a bool that is discarded, so purgeAll() at line 27 runs for any user whose context value userFrom (line 40) returns, and line 28 returns "purged"; the only way this is downgraded is if the route sits behind an admin-only middleware that lives outside this repo.
